_comment: Advanced options. Everyday preferences are in the app's Settings screen (saved to user_settings.json). Your song guides are saved to my_songs.json. Restart the app after editing this file.

trigger._comment: Minimum time between two one-shot gesture actions (e.g. register up/down).

audio._comment: chunk_size: lower = less delay, higher = safer on slow computers (256-2048).

free_play._comment: Gesture -> note. A number 1-7 is a step of the chosen scale (follows the key you pick). A note like "C4" is always that note.
